(1) the optimal ECOP of the absorption refrigerator is a monotonous function with the heat source temperature, and the maximum ECOP of the cycle system can be obtained at the lowest heat source temperature; (2) the optimal ECOR of the cycle system has a maximum, and the maximum value is obtained at a certain heat source temperature; and (3) the maximum value of optimal ECOP and the corresponding optimal heat source temperature are affected by the irreverisibilities of finite-rate
the maximum ECOP is the optimal criterion for four-heat-source refrigeration systems.
the optimal ECOP of the four- heat source absorption refrigerators can be increased by increasing the temperature difference of the hot source and the condensation temperature of the refrigerant.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the thermo-ecological optimum performance of a four heat-source absorption refrigeration system.
the optimal performance of an absorption cycle affected by irreversibilities.
the thermo-ecological optimization of the four- heat-source refrigeration system, which is a general model including the major irreversibilities.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the new thermo- ecological optimal performance criterion of the four- heat-source refrigerator is a more appropriate objective function for the ecological design and optimization of the four- source absorption refrigerator than the conventional performance criterion.

, the maximum of the thermo-ecological objective functions can be obtained when the heat leak rate of the cold space and the heat leakage rate of the generator are both zero, the heat transfer rate of the evaporator and condenser are both equal, and the heat transfer rate between the absorber and generator is equal to the heat transfer rate in the condenser.
the optimal performance criterion of a general four-heat-source system can be achieved when the heat transfer irreversibilities are equal and the heat leak losses of cooled space are equal.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the new thermo- ecological optimal performance of an absorption refrigeration system is not only affected by the irreversible heat transfer between the heat reservoirs and the working fluid, but also the internal irreversibility of the working fluid and heat leak losses of refrigeration space.

the maximum of ECOP of the absorption refrigerator is not only affected by the irreverisbility parameters but also affected by the ratio of the temperature of the heat source 1 to that of the heat source.

the maximum ECOP of the four- heat- source refrigerator is always larger than that of the conventional two-heat-source refrigerator, but the optimal COP of the former is smaller than that of the latter.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the maximum ECOP of the cycle system can be obtained by the proper design of the heat exchanger and evaporator, which may provide a useful guide for the design of the real absorption refrigeration cycle.

, in the presence of the irreversibility of heat leak losses of cooled space and internal dissipation, the maximum ECOP of the cycle system can be achieved when the temperature ratio of the hot source and the cold sink is equal to the square root of the ratio of the heat leak loss rate to the internal dissipation.
the new thermo-eco-optimal criterion can be a useful tool for the design of the four- heat-source refrigerator.
